description: This source file defines the CloudAccountsService class responsible for managing cloud account records, credentials, synchronization, and validation within a cloud resource management platform. It includes functions for listing, creating, updating, deleting, credential management, and simulating sync operations, with database interactions handled via PostgreSQL queries.

classes.name: CloudAccountsService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage cloud accounts and credentials, including CRUD operations, credential validation, and synchronization simulation.

methods.name: list(orgId, options = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of cloud accounts for a specified organization, including latest credential info.

methods.name: create(orgId, userId, input)
methods.description: Creates a new cloud account record along with optional credential data within an organization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific cloud account along with its latest credential.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates cloud account details, optionally rotating credentials and adjusting synchronization parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cloud account after verifying organizational ownership.

methods.name: getCredentialSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of the latest credential for a specified cloud account.

methods.name: putCredentials
methods.description: Inserts or updates credentials for a cloud account, supporting rotation.

methods.name: verifyCredentials
methods.description: Attempts to validate stored credentials by decrypting and validating essential fields.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Simulates a manual sync operation by updating sync status timestamps.
